metadata.description: Standard Azure SRE Agent plugin marketplace for the read-only Azure FinOps pack

plugins.name: azure-finops
plugins.description: Read-only Azure FinOps pack: cost anomalies, rightsizing, allocation, budgets, AI spend, cost vs reliability and executive Live Reports. Say "Set up FinOps for me" and the agent grants its read-only cost roles on your behalf, then creates the scheduled reports. Budget planning only produces a script for a human to review and run.
